name: What kind of maintenance do new basement windows require?

mainEntity.name: What kind of maintenance do new basement windows require?

acceptedAnswer.text: New basement windows generally require minimal maintenance. Regular cleaning of the glass and frames with mild soap and water will keep them looking good. It's advisable to periodically check the weatherstripping and seals for any signs of wear or damage to maintain energy efficiency and prevent drafts. Lubricating moving parts on slider or casement windows can ensure smooth operation. Proper drainage around the window wells, if applicable, is also important to prevent water accumulation near the foundation.
acceptedAnswer.description: New basement windows require regular cleaning, periodic checks of weatherstripping and seals, lubrication of moving parts, and ensuring proper window well drainage.
